Lab Projects

Project 01
Enterprise Network Infrastructure
Networking

Designed and simulated a complete small enterprise network topology with multi-floor support and inter-VLAN routing.

  • Multi-floor topology using Cisco routers & switches
  • VLANs for HR, Finance, IT departments
  • DHCP server for automatic IP assignment
  • Port security & access control policies
Project 02
Dynamic Routing Configuration
Routing Protocols

Configured and compared dynamic routing protocols across a multi-router topology for performance analysis.

  • RIP v2, EIGRP, and OSPF configuration
  • Route propagation and summarization
  • Convergence time analysis per protocol
  • End-to-end connectivity verification
Project 03
ACL Security Implementation
Security

Implemented layered access control to filter and control traffic between network departments using ACLs.

  • Standard ACLs for source IP filtering
  • Extended ACLs for protocol & port filtering
  • Simulated unauthorized access testing
  • Improved network security posture
Project 04
NAT and PAT Configuration
Address Translation

Enabled internal-to-external communication using all three forms of Network Address Translation.

  • Static NAT for server public IP mapping
  • Dynamic NAT for host pool access
  • PAT for shared single public IP
  • Internet access simulation & verification
Project 05
Switching & VLAN Management
Switching

Implemented advanced switching features for traffic segmentation, redundancy, and bandwidth optimization.

  • VLANs with 802.1Q trunking
  • STP to prevent Layer-2 loops
  • EtherChannel (LACP) for link aggregation
  • Port security against unauthorized devices
Project 06
Network Troubleshooting Lab
Diagnostics

Developed systematic troubleshooting skills using Cisco CLI diagnostic tools and OSI-model methodology.

  • Diagnosed routing loops with debug commands
  • Fixed incorrect subnetting configurations
